info.title: LankaHealthChain Demo API
info.description: Synthetic-data-only interoperability prototype. Local consent is NOT Midnight ZK verification and local integrity is NOT Cardano confirmation. Never connect real patient information. API error responses include X-Request-ID. Optional doctor-scoped request idempotency.

get.description: Process responding; database may still be unavailable.
Returns 503 if Core PostgreSQL query fails.
No facility administrative secrets or clinical data.

post.description: Patient approval deadline is 24h. This does not grant consent. Optional Idempotency-Key deduplicates retries across API replicas; reuse with different body returns 409.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Opaque doctor-scoped retry key; same key + changed request returns 409. Concurrent retries share the same request ID.
